summary: Ruthenium thin films were grown on thermally-grown SiO2 substrates using atomic layer deposition (ALD) by a sequential supply of (ethylbenzene)(1,3-cyclohexadiene)Ru(0) (EBCHDRu) and molecular oxygen (O2) at deposition temperatures ranging from 140 to 350 °C. The study evaluated the feasibility of ALD-Ru films as a seed layer for Cu electroplating.
evidence: Ruthenium (Ru) thin ﬁlms were grown on thermally-grown SiO2 substrates using atomic layer deposition (ALD) by a sequential supply of (ethylbenzene)(1,3-cyclohexadiene)Ru(0) (EBCHDRu), and molecular oxygen (O2) at deposition temperatures ranging from 140 to 350 °C. Finally, the ALD-Ru ﬁlm was evaluated in terms of its performance as a seed layer for Cu electroplating.
